observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with wooden flooring, backdrop screen, and theatrical lighting in front of a seated audience.
observation.formation_and_space: Horizontal line across the stage shifting into a circular formation and back.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slightly bent knees and weight shifting dynamically.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and pivoting on the beat in time with the music.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms raised and gesturing while holding small clay pots (matkas).
observation.hips_and_torso: Subtle hip movement and torso turns accompanying the stepping and arm gestures.
observation.partnering: None, performed in a group formation.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent spins and occasional low dips toward the floor.
observation.costume_and_props: Colorful traditional long skirts, matching tops, and dupattas (scarves) covering the head; holding small clay pots.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placements and subtle weight shifts are obscured by wide stage shots and fast skirt movement.

signature_moments.what: Dancers spin in a circle while holding clay pots and gesturing with one hand.
Dancers pivot in a circle holding clay pots and raising one arm high.
Dancers balance clay pots on their heads while walking in a circle.
Dancers weave in a circle holding clay pots out to the side.
Dancers line up across the stage, stepping rhythmically with arms raised.
